info.name: SAFEST - FHIR API - AT - Hackathon
info.description:
This is a Postman collection for interacting with the FHIR API's of SAFEST, with basic requests set up for both server owner and client purposes. This is reflected by a division into two subfolders, **External FHIR Endpoint** and **Internal FHIR Endpoint.** **External FHIR Endpoint** contains requests for the endpoints used by external clients via the Azure API Management gateway. Use this for reading FHIR data on the latest published build. **Internal FHIR Endpoint** contains requests for the endpoints on the Azure FHIR Server, used by the distribution module. Use this for either reading from or writing data to specific FHIR builds. Read the description of each sub folder for how to use. ## **Variables** **Internal FHIR Endpoint** | **Variable** | **Description** | **Requires user value** | | --- | --- | --- | | client_id | Client ID for authenticating with Azure AD for OIDC.
Either use an existing client with FHIR read and write permissions or create one in Azure AD.

Update variable value to the relevant client ID. | Yes | | client_secret | Client Secret for authenticating with Azure AD for OIDC.
Either use an existing client with FHIR read and write permissions or create one in Azure AD.

Update variable value to the relevant client secret. | Yes | | grant_type | Grant type for the OIDC flow - always *client_credentials*. | No | | tenant_id | Azure AD tenant, do not change. | No | | host_snapshot_published | URL for the snapshot endpoint of a specific FHIR build. Update to which FHIR build requests should go to. | Yes | | host_delta_published | URL for the delta API. | No | | audience_snapshot | Audience required for authorization with Azure AD for snapshot. | No | | audience_delta | Audience required for authorization with Azure AD for delta. | No | **External FHIR Endpoint** | **Variable** | **Description** | **Requires user value** | | --- | --- | --- | | public_endpoint | URL for the snapshot API - statically defined by the API gateway, do not change. | No | | public_endpoint_delta | URL for the delta API - statically defined by the API gateway, do not change. | No | | subscription_key | Subscription key for authorization. Update value to your own subscription key. | Yes |

item.description:
These requests concern the "Delta" FHIR API. While the FHIR build ID, changes over time for snapshot, it is static for delta.

Whereas for Snapshot, there will be no history on entities, as it is a one-time publishing process, requests to the delta API can either fetch the latest version of each entity, or use the /_history endpoints with optional filters, to look through the changes on FHIR entities.

This folder contains requests for interacting directly with FHIR endpoints for a specific FHIR build.

For FHIR Server management, set up the collection by adding a client ID and secret into the variable values, for automatic OIDC authentication.

Also remember to add the correct URL in the endpoint variable, for the FHIR build you want to test on.

These values can be found in Azure under App Registrations in Azure AD for the ID, and under Azure Key Vault for the secret.

When making a request, a pre-request script on the collection will run, which fetches an access token and adds it to the request authorization header.

The authentication step has also been added as its own request, in case manual token gathering is desired. For these specific requests, the pre-request script will not run.

request.description:
The purpose of this request is to be able to search a package tree for an identifier regardless of package level. This is achieved via a set of custom search parameters.

While it is not possible to create a recursive search implementation, it must be done so by the client.

Some sample javascript has been added to the Test part of this request, which will run if the Identifier query parameter is used for the base request.

item.description:
These requests concern the "Delta" FHIR API. While the FHIR build ID, changes over time for snapshot, it is static for delta.

Whereas for Snapshot, there will be no history on entities, as it is a one-time publishing process, requests to the delta API can either fetch the latest version of each entity, or use the /_history endpoints with optional filters, to look through the changes on FHIR entities.
